text.description_html:
Acorn Cast Iron Air Register

Acorn cast iron register with louvers adds beauty and character to any room in your home. From old home restoration to new construction, traditional to contemporary, acorn decorative air registers compliments any style home. Made of solid cast iron, each register is durable and crafted with care with careful attention to design, authenticity and craftsmanship. Traditional matte black finish.

Acorn also makes: Cast Iron Grills

Features of the of the Black Cast Iron Registers:

  • Solid cast iron.
  • Available with screw holes and screws for wall opening or without for floor openings.
  • Available in 5 size design fit standard 2-1/4", 4" and 6" heading ducts.
  • Traditional matte black finish.
  • Easy to install.

Available Sizes:

    GL1BG
    • Overall Length: 12"
    • Overall Width: 5-1/2"
    • Inner Lip Length: 10"
    • Inner Lip Width: 4"

    GL2BG
    • Overall Length: 14"
    • Overall Width: 5-1/2"
    • Inner Lip Length: 12"
    • Inner Lip Width: 4"

    GL3BG
    • Overall Length: 12"
    • Overall Width: 8"
    • Inner Lip Length: 10"
    • Inner Lip Width: 6"

    GL4BG
    • Overall Length: 14"
    • Overall Width: 8"
    • Inner Lip Length: 12"
    • Inner Lip Width: 6"

    GL5BG
    • Overall Length: 12"
    • Overall Width: 10"
    • Inner Lip Length: 10"
    • Inner Lip Width: 8"

Sold Individually
